name: Hakase (Detailed)
reference: The user explicitly selected the upper, more detailed illustration from a comparison of two Clover designs. The exact original full-resolution transparent artwork is reused as the canonical reference. The screenshot itself is excluded.
brief: Retain fuller layered green hair and rich shading, large mint goggles, the detailed ivory coat with sleeves, folded cuffs, lapels and longer hem, fitted dark-green wrap bodice with diagonal ivory trim, pleated skirt with ivory hem, and tall cuffed boots with diamond motifs and piping. Keep the chosen upper design's taller proportions and expressive face. Preserve the simpler Clover separately; do not replace this detail with a plain dress, generic short coat or plain ankle boots.
processing: Built-in ImageGen re-grounded every state and gaze row in the chosen detailed canonical artwork. Bundled work-pets 0.1.6 extraction, frame inspection, atlas composition, cardinal anchors, shared gaze registration, alpha cleanup, structural/quality validation and independent visual checks are reused. Standard rows use uniform row-wide scale/ground registration; side profiles inherit idle scale. Final PNG encoding is lossless. Generated pet pixels are not manually redrawn. GIF export uses shared palette, no dithering and alpha threshold128. Row10 source pixel density is normalized once with a uniform whole-strip resampling (417/447), then both gaze rows use the identical recorded row9 registration scale. No final cell is independently resized or recentered.
